notes.ko:

notes.en:
· 🔧 Fixed the "Updated" popup appearing over the install prompt when an app install was still needed
· 🔧 Fixed update prompts not appearing after skipping an earlier version; checks every minute on return
· 🎵 Music player widget on your home screen (app 5.12)
· 🗂️ Cleaner add-ons: file & app manager, photo cleanup, media compression, widget, status bar (app 5.11)
· 🧪 Labs moved to Settings
· 🧹 Phone Cleaner: junk, duplicates, large files, app caches, trash, device info — free, no ads (app 5.10)
· 💬 Support chatbot: Settings → Support (contact the admin via HappyTalk)
· 🛡️ Block screenshots & recording: toggle in Settings (app 5.9.1)
· 🧊 Penguin Defense 3D: 3D battlefield and characters
· 🐧 1000 stages, saved progress, boss every 10 stages
· 📱 Use your phone font: Samsung font style, installed font apps, or a font file (Settings → Font)
· 🔊 Penguin Defense upgrade: music & SFX, crits, knockback, Shark King boss
· 🐧 New mini-game: Penguin Defense
· 🎵 YouTube Music: open in-app or in its app, search, find the playing song
· 📚 English Bites: daily word cards, spaced review, quizzes, pronunciation (app 5.8)
· 🎁 Daily Happy: check in at your chosen time window, missions, fortune
· 🔢 2048 puzzle
· Admins can check in any time
